description:
The caller's Delopt plan and what is left of it: vehicle and rate limits,
today's address lookups, the free trial and how to upgrade.

Use it when a plan is refused for a limit, or when the user asks about their
plan, trial or remaining lookups. It spends no lookups.
name: get_account_status

limit_per_day.description: Daily budget of address lookups (UTC day); null = unlimited
limit_per_day.title: Limit Per Day

remaining_today.description: Lookups left today; null when the plan is unlimited
remaining_today.title: Remaining Today

channel.description: full (web app, REST API and MCP) or mcp (AI assistants only)
channel.title: Channel

free_trial_available.description: True when the account can still start a free trial
free_trial_available.title: Free Trial Available

notice.description: Something to pass on to the user, e.g. a trial that ended
notice.title: Notice

plan.description: free, basic, advanced, pro, enterprise or demo
plan.title: Plan

trial.description: The free trial, while one is running

title: Check account status
